steps: 1. Record the execution contract in new docs/design/spec/reconstruction-profile-v1.md and docs/design/fixtures/p04-reconstruction-cases-v1.json; maintain data/accounting-master/deliverables/P04/progress.md. Question: do declared inputs generate the correct joint family within the declared scope? Comparators: independent exact enumeration and algebra. Passing requires matching feasible sets, numerical semantics, coverage and provenance; solver success alone is insufficient. Record material defaults with provenance, justification, failure mode, early diagnostic and status. Missing dependencies/protection evidence or changed protected inputs stop acceptance; failed cases trigger repair. Skeptical audit: the prior plan's material flaw was treating named views as potential search choices. The revised separation below removes that ambiguity; no speed ranking, weak comparator or proxy promotion is proposed.

2. Add scripts/reconstruction_v1.py with versioned inputs/results and explicit validation of registry templates, openings, slots, contextual observations, admissions, mappings and budgets. Distinguish three records: parent-family constraints P; named conditional predicates A_i; genuine finite choices. The P03 adapter consumes validated IR plus explicit template bindings, preserves provenance, and maps choice_group=null alternatives to named views only. Parent queries use P; selecting a view uses P AND A_i without mutating P. Multiple-view intersection or union requires an explicit query operator. Neither exclusivity, exhaustiveness nor weights follow from labels.

3. Construct constraints from inputs. Instantiate each declared slot once with activation and nonnegative amount; inactive implies zero. Derive dated roll-forwards and report expressions from posting incidence and economic-state coefficients. Share symbols by economic IDs and attach each accepted observation domain once with source/assumption IDs. Keep view predicates outside parent constraints and the choice enumeration. Genuine choice guards apply jointly across accounts/dates. For overlapping Boolean guards, create disjoint decision-prefix cells, preserving their exact union; verify disjointness and coverage or leave coverage uncertified. Preserve unmatched obligations and explicit scope exclusions.

4. Add scripts/rational_solver_v1.py. Classify expressions before solving; enumerate genuine finite choices and bounded integer assignments lazily while retaining continuous regions symbolically. Implement F+V=D amount parameterisation with documented equivalence conditions. Rewrite constant fraction restrictions only under proved denominator-sign conditions; P03's exact positive principal permits alpha=F/D. Unknown products, unsupported functions and unbounded integer domains return UnsupportedFragment/Unknown with the original expression, never Infeasible.

5. Implement explicit rounding and bound semantics. Preserve open/closed disclosure endpoints; support exact half-even posting quantisation and bounded minor-unit symbolic cases without continuous relaxation of integers. Establish feasibility on original constraints first. For each feasible convex linear cell, optimise its closed relaxation, certify no better value, and test endpoint attainment against the original strict constraints. Record rational bounds, witnesses, proof queries, scope and rounding stage. Distinguish Unbounded from Unknown; unknown optimisation/proof/attainment checks leave the affected conclusion uncertified. Recheck source-labelled unsatisfiable cores without claiming minimality.

6. Preserve joint queries and unfinished work. Coverage counts genuine choice/partition/integer cells, never conditional-view labels; a parent with no genuine choices has one symbolic cell despite multiple views. Each conditional query gets separate scope and coverage metadata. Record total, completed, feasible, infeasible and unresolved cells with a defined counting convention. Enforce slot, formula-size, integer-assignment, cell, solver-resource and elapsed-time limits; retain unvisited regions compactly. Feasible witnesses may coexist with PartialSearch. Infeasible requires all relevant cells proved infeasible; ExactWithinScope additionally requires all applicable obligations resolved or explicitly outside scope. Partial-cell extrema remain explored bounds. Preserve formulas and branch identities, testing joint output tuples against shared constraints.

7. Retain bounded uncertainty, probability and resolution operations. Validate ExtractionReading, HistoricalFact, AccountingElection, MeasurementEstimate, BehaviourPolicy and FutureInnovation against required admission/provenance fields. Separate factual constraints, hypothetical stress and likelihood updates. Finite probabilities require an explicit joint measure on disjoint economic hypotheses; overlapping views are events over that measure, not additional atoms. Preserve unresolved/default mass and reject summaries requiring unavailable outcomes. Permit documented additive grouping only with retained contract memory, matching rate/reset/maturity/hedge keys and checked transition/report preservation for the requested scenario and horizon. Changed requirements force revalidation; approximate or unproved grouping remains unsupported.

8. Implement tests/test_accounting_p04.py and independent oracles using small known-history fixtures plus selected immutable Northstar and borrowing inputs. Independently replay templates to generate observations, withholding hidden histories and authored expected constraints from production reconstruction. Compare complete finite sets and analytic continuous bounds. Include the parent/interior, isolated conditional-query and overlapping-view integration assertions listed in checks; endpoint extrema alone cannot establish preservation of the parent family. Tie every fixture obligation to executed assertions and include metamorphic input changes.

9. Add scripts/check_accounting_p04.py and generate data/accounting-master/deliverables/P04/conformance.json and result.md. Preserve actual input/source/test hashes, generated constraints, witnesses/conflicts, endpoint results, parent/view query identities, partition coverage, oracle comparisons and test outcomes. Include the decision table, strongest alternative explanation, exclusions and unfinished work. Record command, interpreter/package versions, CPU-only execution, deterministic seed status, wall time, reviewed-plan reference, execution inventory and every changed file. Compare protected-file hashes before/after; avoid importing legacy scripts with output-writing side effects. Update progress after meaningful edits and finish checks before the reserved response interval.
summary: Revised P04 plan preserves P03's parent continuous family and overlapping conditional views. Only genuine finite choices or justified exhaustive partitions create search cells; targeted integration tests detect loss of unnamed interior histories.
